pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: MARCH 4, 1985. JEROME PARK, THE BRONX, NYC

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: HUH? DOES KOMABA SEEM DIFFERENT THAN USUAL?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: HE'S DOING REALLY WELL. IT LOOKS LIKE HE'S BEEN WORKING HARD FOR THE FALL TOURNAMENT.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: NO, THAT'S NOT IT. IT'S LIKE HE'S...

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: RIGHT HERE! THIS IS WHERE IT HAPPENS!

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: DO YOU HAVE TO KEEP WATCHING THAT? IT'S EMBARRASSING.

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: IT'S ALL FOR THE SAKE OF OUR CLUB. WE'RE GOING TO ANALYZE IT IN DETAIL LATER.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: YOU'RE STILL ALIVE AFTER GETTING CUT TO PIECES?!

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I REALLY HATE YOU DEVIL HUNTERS!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WHY DID THEY WANT A BETTER LIFE

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WHEN THEY WERE ALREADY SO WELL OFF?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: AS LONG AS I HAD POCHITA THAT WAS ENOUGH,

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: BUT I STILL DREAMED OF A BETTER LIFE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I GET IT. EVERYONE'S GOT THEIR OWN DREAMS.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THERE'S NOTHIN' WRONG WITH THAT, BUT...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THE GUY LYING FACE-DOWN IS HIS BODYGUARD.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: THIS IS THE THIRD CASE THIS YEAR IN OUR JURISDICTION ALONE.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: 'COURSE, THEIR HANDS WERE PRETTY BLOODY TO BEGIN WITH.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: OTHER PEOPLE'S LIVES DIDN'T MEAN A THING TO THEM...

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: ...BUT THEIR OWN, THEY HAD A PRETTY HIGH OPINION OF.

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: I THINK CHARLIE HAS THE LIST...

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: THE FIRST WAS ON JANUARY THE FIFTH. RICHARD BACH, AGED 45. LIVED ON EAST 152ND.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: SHOT HIMSELF IN THE RIGHT TEMPLE WITH A .380 WAD-CUTTER.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: IN THE SECOND CASE, THE IMPORTER -- ALSO UNDER INVESTIGATION FOR SMUGGLING. THIS TIME THERE WERE WITNESSES WHO SAW HIM JUMP OUT HIS APARTMENT WINDOW... RIGHT IN THE MIDDLE OF A FAMILY DINNER.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: AND NOW JERRY WATTS SLITS HIS OWN THROAT WITH A STRAIGHT RAZOR!

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: JUMPING OUT A WINDOW... GUNSHOT TO THE HEAD... ORTHODOX SUICIDE.

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: NO, NOT MUCH ROOM FOR SUSPICION.

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: SAY YOU'RE ACTUALLY HARDCORE ENOUGH TO GO BY CUTTING YOUR OWN THROAT. BUT YOU'VE GOT A BODYGUARD. WELL, SIMPLE WAY WOULD BE IN THE JOHN. WHEN THE KNOCK COMES ON THE DOOR, TEN MINUTES LATER, TUB'S FULL.

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: BUT OUR MR. WATTS... FOR SOME REASON, HE LIKED THINGS COMPLICATED. FOR HE FELT THE NEED TO SNEAK UP BEHIND HIS BODYGUARD... AND TAKE THE GOOD TIME AND TROUBLE TO CUT HIS THROAT FIRST.

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: READ IT AND YOU'LL FIND IT THAT MUCH HARDER TO BELIEVE HE'D COMMIT SUICIDE.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: BEAT THE RAP ON A FRAUD COUNT THREE TIMES.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: EATING BREAD WITH JAM SMOTHERED ALL OVER IT WITH YOU POCHITA, MAKIN' OUT WITH A GIRL, PLAYIN' GAMES TOGETHER IN OUR ROOM... AND FALLIN' ASLEEP IN HER ARMS...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: PRETTY GREAT DREAM, DON'T YOU THINK?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: MY MOM... DIED FROM A HEART ISSUE THAT MADE HER COUGH UP BLOOD...

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: DENJI, WE'VE GOT ANOTHER DEVIL. TIME TO WORK.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: AT LEAST LET ME DREAM A LITTLE...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: HEY, MURPHY. WHAT'RE YOU GONNA DO WHEN YOU GET BACK HOME?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: HA, HA, HA! WHAT AM I GONNA DO?

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: STAY BACK, MAN! HE'S LOST IT!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IS THERE SOME KIND OF PROBLEM WITH THAT? IT'S ONLY FISH. WHY CAN'T YOU JUST TOUCH IT?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: IT'S RAW FISH! IT'S ALL SLIMY AND SLIPPERY AND COLD!

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I CAN'T... JUST THINKING ABOUT IT IS MAKING ME SICK...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I'M GONNA BE HONEST, YOU SOUND KIND OF LIKE A LITTLE GIRL RIGHT NOW...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT'S NOT LIKE IT'LL ACTUALLY BE LIVE FISH, RIGHT? AND IF YOU DON'T USE IT, IT'LL JUST GET THROWN AWAY!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THAT WOULD BE RUDE TO THE FISH!

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I DON'T EVEN KNOW HOW TO RESPOND TO THAT...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: WELL, IF IT ISN'T ALIVE, THEN I GUESS I COULD JUST BARELY DO IT...

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: THAT THEY EVEN GOT A FISH TANK LAST YEAR.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: IT'LL BE KIND OF GROSS. THINK YOU'LL BE OKAY?

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: I'M A DOCTOR'S SON, REMEMBER? I'LL BE FINE.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THAT SOUNDS LIKE THEY'RE GOING TO BE ALIVE...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: WE'RE GOING TO BE CUTTING UP LIVE FISH, AREN'T WE?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: W... WELL, YOU DO NEED THAT TO KEEP THEM ALIVE... YEAH.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I CAN'T EVEN TOUCH DEAD FISH! AND NOW THEY'RE GOING TO BE ALIVE!!?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: YOU HAVE GOT TO BE KIDDING ME!!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: W... WELL, TELLING ME ISN'T GOING TO SOLVE ANYTHING...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: IF WE DO COOKING PRACTICE LIKE THIS...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT WILL BE DANGEROUS IF THE NEWCOMERS WERE TO HAVE A STANDOFF WITH THE TARGET GHOUL...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I MUST GO AHEAD AND STOP THEM EVEN MORE THAN I'D HAVE TO GO FOR A SUBORDINATE...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: WE HAVE OUR OWN WAY OF DOING THINGS, SO PLEASE GIVE UP.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: ...OR PERHAPS I SHOULD SAY, RANK 1 SASAKI, WAS IT?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THE SOURCE OF ALL THIS FROM THE START WAS

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THAT YOU COULDN'T CONTROL YOUR SUBORDINATES, WASN'T IT?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: AND WITH THAT REASON DEMANDING "HAND OVER YOUR DATA"...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: IS NOTHING MORE THAN TYRANNY, DON'T YOU THINK?

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: SENSEI... LET'S GO ALREADY... WE DON'T HAVE TIME FOR...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT'S JUST AS YOU SAID; I MISMANAGED CONTROL...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I AGREE THAT TELLING YOU TO FREELY SHOW ME YOUR

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: PRECIOUS DATA CAN ONLY BE CALLED TYRANNICAL...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I DO NOT WANT TO EXPOSE MY SUBORDINATES TO DANGER DUE TO MY CARELESSNESS...!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IF WE MAKE AN ACHIEVEMENT THEN WE WILL HAND THAT OVER TO YOU.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IF YOU'D JUST GIVE US THE DATA...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: DID YOU THINK IT'D TURN OUT ALRIGHT IF YOU JUST BOWED YOUR HEAD...?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: HOW TROUBLESOME. DOING THINGS LIKE THIS...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: IS THAT SORT OF THING FITTING FOR A GHOUL INVESTIGATOR?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: LISTEN TO ME. YOU, ALL OF YOU GUYS,

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: EVEN IF IT WERE A HUMAN THAT'S AN "UPRIGHT INVESTIGATOR" DOING THIS SORT OF THING,

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: AH... UM.. ARE YOU ALL RIGHT?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: OKAY. IT'S HARD, BUT I CAN TOUCH THE FISH.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: BLOOD'S THE ONE THING I CAN'T DEAL WITH!!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: HOW MANY ONE THINGS YOU CAN'T DEAL WITH ARE THERE!!?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: OKAY THEN... I DIDN'T WANT TO HAVE TO RESORT TO THIS...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: BUT I DON'T HAVE A CHOICE...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THIS IS MY BIG SISTER'S PRIZED STASH.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IF YOU CAN MAKE IT THROUGH THESE SLASHER MOVIES, ONE OR TWO FISH WILL BE NOTHING!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I DON'T LIKE SCARY STUFF EITHER... BUT I CAN'T JUST LEAVE YOU HERE, SO I'LL STAY...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ...IT'S COMING. THERE'S GONNA BE BLOOD EVERYWHERE!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: HUH? YOU'RE NOT MOVING AT ALL, PRESIDENT?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THIS IS A LOT EASIER THAN I THOUGHT IT'D BE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I'M SCARED TOO!! YOU'RE THE WHOLE REASON WE'RE DOING THIS, SO YOU CAN'T COVER YOUR EYES!!

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: LOOK, MY EYES ARE WIDE OPEN!! JUST LIKE A FISH!!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THEN KEEP THEM THAT WAY!! DON'T CLOSE THEM AN INCH!!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THE MAJORITY ARE THE RESULT OF NEGATIVE ENERGY THAT FLOWS OUT OF PEOPLE...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT DOESN'T MATTER IF YOU BELIEVE ME OR NOT!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: PLACES WHERE CROWDS GATHER, LIKE SCHOOLS OR HOSPITALS...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: PAIN, REGRET, HUMILIATION... THE MORE PEOPLE DWELL ON BAD MEMORIES...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ...THE MORE THESE PLACES BECOME RECEPTIVE TO THOSE FEELINGS.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: FOR THAT REASON, A CURSED OBJECT IS OFTEN FOUND AT SUCH PLACES AS A TALISMAN.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THE OBJECT YOU FOUND IS SUCH AN ITEM.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: ISN'T THAT A GOOD THING? HOW'S THAT DANGEROUS?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THE MORE EVIL PLACED ON A CURSED OBJECT, THE MORE IT DEFLECTS OTHER CURSES.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: USING POISON TO FEND OFF POISON.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: AFTER MANY YEARS, THE SEAL WEAKENS AND THE TALISMAN ESSENTIALLY CHANGES FORM.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THEN IT ATTRACTS CURSES AND FEEDS ON THEM.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: COMPARED TO OTHER CURSED OBJECTS, THE ONE PLACED AT YOUR SCHOOL IS EXTREMELY DANGEROUS AND IS CATEGORIZED AS SPECIAL GRADE.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: LIKE I SAID, I DON'T CARE.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: BUT YOU BETTER EXPLAIN THIS TO MY FRIENDS!

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: LIKE I SAID! THE OCCULT RESEARCH CLUB HAS IT!

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: NOT SURE... SOMEWHERE OVER IN THE IZUMI DISTRICT...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: NO. YOU'RE DEFINITELY NOT ALL RIGHT.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: HOW DO YOU KNOW... WHO ARE YOU?!

pages.text: "THOSE GUYS AND MADO'S DAUGHTER ARE THE DISGRACES OF THE CCG"

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IF WE'RE COMPARED TO THE PRESENT HIRAKO SQUAD,

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THEN TRUTHFULLY IT SEEMS WE'RE GETTING RESULTS FOR LESS THAN ONE IN THREE.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: OH MAN... THAT NAN SURE DOES LOOK DELICIOUS.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: IS THE NANCHALANT THOUGHT I WAS HAVING.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THAT WAS A SPICY JOKE, HUH?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: SEEMS LIKE YOU NEED TO "IMPROVE" YOUR EDUCATION.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WHEN YOU WERE LEFT IN CHARGE OF THE "QUINX",

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: To "create investigators who would surpass Arima Kishou", didn't he?

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: is a ghoul investigator with the highest rank of "Special Class".

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: He is praised as the strongest within the CCG and is undefeated.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ...YOU UNDERSTAND THE PLACE THAT WE, AT THE CCG, HAVE BEEN PUT INTO RIGHT NOW, DON'T YOU?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THE AFOREMENTIONED GHOUL ORGANIZATION IS CONTINUING TO INCREASE THEIR STRENGTH.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ...WE ALSO HAVE TO FIGHT AGAINST THOSE GUYS, IN ADDITION TO DOING THE NORMAL INVESTIGATIONS.

pages.speaker: character1

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: SECURING NEW, STRONG, BATTLE-CAPABLE PEOPLE IS URGENT BUSINESS.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THE QUINX MEMBERS THAT YOU'RE COMMANDING CAN BECOME AN EARNEST HOPE FOR THE CCG.

pages.text: IN ORDER TO MAKE "INVESTIGATORS WHO SURPASS ARIMA KISHOU"

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YOU YOURSELF HAVE TO SURPASS HIM TOO.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: RELAX... I JUST CAME TO TALK.

pages.text: YOU KNOW, I THOUGHT YOU MIGHT COME, BUT I WASN'T EXPECTING YOU QUITE SO EARLY.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: WOULD YOU CARE TO JOIN ME?

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: ARE YOU SURE? THE BACON'S WONDERFUL. A FARM IN SURREY.

pages.text: I DIDN'T COME ALL THE WAY OUT HERE TO EAT.

pages.text: YOU HAVE A MESSAGE FROM SPECIAL CLASS ARIMA.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: HE SAID "I WILL BE RETURNING THE BOOK I BORROWED, SO TELL ME A CONVENIENT TIME."

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: ...THOUGH IT'S FINE NOT TO DO IT PERSONALLY,

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: JEEZ, IS HE BEING CONSCIENTIOUS, OR NANT...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: AH, THAT "NANT" CAN HAVE ANOTHER "NAN" IN IT...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: HE WANTS TO MEET YOU AFTER SUCH A LONG WHILE, DOESN'T HE?

pages.text: I WONDER IF THAT GUY HAS THAT SORT OF FEELING...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I'LL TRY GOING OVER THERE WHEN THE INVESTIGATION CALMS DOWN.

pages.text: HOW ABOUT I STRIVE FOR A HUG?

pages.text: MY ANEMIA WAS ACTING UP AGAIN...

pages.text: THERE WAS AN INCIDENT OF "GROWLING SOUNDS OF A BEAST" BEING HEARD FROM THE NEIGHBORHOOD.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: AND THE LADY WAS WORRIED THAT "IT MIGHT BE A GHOUL"...

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: BUT, AS A RESULT OF RANK 3 YONEBAYASHI AND I INVESTIGATING AROUND THE AREA,

pages.text: WE ASCERTAINED THAT IN TRUTH IT WAS JUST A STRAY DOG,

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: THAT HAD MADE THE NEIGHBORHOOD ITS HOME, GROWLING BEHIND THE LADY'S HOUSE.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: So it was just a beast.

pages.text: WHEN WE INFORMED THE LADY OF THAT SHE SAID "FROM TODAY ON, I'LL BE ABLE TO SLEEP SOUNDLY"

pages.text: THAT'S WHERE THIS NEWSPAPER ARTICLE FROM 30 YEARS AGO COMES IN!
